{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print("QA orders found:", len(qa_orders))
print("QA orders by customer_segment:\n", qa_orders['customer_segment'].value_counts())

# Check conversion status of QA orders
print("QA orders conversion rate:", qa_orders['converted'].mean())"}
